1	"""Finite, explicit theory-model replay. This is not a Morphisms runtime.
2	
3	A transition has an event kind, guards and ordered set/create/append/delete
4	mutations. Values support {$arg: name}, {$state: path}, {$event: field}.
5	The model is authored data; the engine never extracts rules from prose.
6	Each event commits atomically and failed events leave state/revision untouched.
7	"""
8	import argparse
9	import copy
10	import hashlib
11	import json
12	from pathlib import Path
13	
14	VERSION='finite-replay/1'
15	MISSING=object()
16	
17	class ReplayError(ValueError):
18	    pass
19	
20	def digest(value):
21	    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
22	
23	def value(spec,state,event):
24	    if isinstance(spec,dict):
25	        if len(spec)==1 and '$arg' in spec:
26	            key=spec['$arg']
27	            if key not in event.get('args',{}): raise ReplayError('missing-argument:'+str(key))
28	            return copy.deepcopy(event['args'][key])
29	        if len(spec)==1 and '$event' in spec:
30	            if spec['$event'] not in event: raise ReplayError('missing-event-field:'+spec['$event'])
31	            return copy.deepcopy(event[spec['$event']])
32	        if len(spec)==1 and '$state' in spec:
33	            result=read(state,path_value(spec['$state'],state,event))
34	            if result is MISSING: raise ReplayError('missing-state-reference')
35	            return copy.deepcopy(result)
36	        return {k:value(v,state,event) for k,v in spec.items()}
37	    if isinstance(spec,list): return [value(v,state,event) for v in spec]
38	    return copy.deepcopy(spec)
39	
40	def path_value(path,state,event):
41	    if not isinstance(path,list) or not path: raise ReplayError('path-must-be-nonempty-list')
42	    result=[value(p,state,event) for p in path]
43	    if any(not isinstance(p,str) or not p for p in result): raise ReplayError('path-segments-must-be-strings')
44	    return result
45	
46	def read(state,path):
47	    current=state
48	    for part in path:
49	        if not isinstance(current,dict) or part not in current:return MISSING
50	        current=current[part]
51	    return current
52	
53	def guard_holds(guard,state,event):
54	    allowed={'path','equals','not_equals','exists','includes'}
55	    if set(guard)-allowed: raise ReplayError('unsupported-guard')
56	    actual=read(state,path_value(guard['path'],state,event))
57	    operators=[k for k in ('equals','not_equals','exists','includes') if k in guard]
58	    if len(operators)!=1: raise ReplayError('guard-needs-one-operator')
59	    op=operators[0];expected=value(guard[op],state,event)
60	    if op=='exists':return (actual is not MISSING)==expected
61	    if actual is MISSING:return False
62	    if op=='equals':return actual==expected
63	    if op=='not_equals':return actual!=expected
64	    if op=='includes':return isinstance(actual,(list,dict,str)) and expected in actual
65	    raise ReplayError('unsupported-guard')
66	
67	def mutate(state,effect,event):
68	    op=effect.get('op');path=path_value(effect.get('path'),state,event)
69	    parent=read(state,path[:-1]) if len(path)>1 else state
70	    if not isinstance(parent,dict):raise ReplayError('missing-parent')
71	    key=path[-1]
72	    if op=='create':
73	        if key in parent:raise ReplayError('already-exists')
74	        parent[key]=value(effect['value'],state,event)
75	    elif op=='set':
76	        if key not in parent:raise ReplayError('missing-update-target')
77	        parent[key]=value(effect['value'],state,event)
78	    elif op=='delete':
79	        if key not in parent:raise ReplayError('missing-delete-target')
80	        del parent[key]
81	    elif op=='append':
82	        if not isinstance(parent.get(key),list):raise ReplayError('append-requires-list')
83	        parent[key].append(value(effect['value'],state,event))
84	    else:raise ReplayError('unsupported-effect:'+str(op))
85	
86	def run(model,events,checkpoint=None):
87	    """Return exact finite state/receipts; resume only against the same model hash."""
88	    fingerprint=digest(model)
89	    if checkpoint is not None:
90	        if checkpoint.get('model_hash')!=fingerprint:raise ReplayError('checkpoint-model-mismatch')
91	        state=copy.deepcopy(checkpoint['state']);revision=checkpoint['revision'];seen=set(checkpoint['seen'])
92	    else:state=copy.deepcopy(model.get('initial',{}));revision=0;seen=set()
93	    receipts=[];rules=model.get('rules',[])
94	    if len({r.get('id') for r in rules})!=len(rules) or any(not r.get('id') for r in rules):raise ReplayError('unique-rule-ids-required')
95	    for event in events:
96	        before=digest(state);eid=event.get('id');receipt={'event':eid,'before_revision':revision,'before_hash':before}
97	        try:
98	            if not isinstance(eid,str) or not eid:raise ReplayError('event-id-required')
99	            if eid in seen:raise ReplayError('duplicate-event')
100	            if 'expect_revision' in event and event['expect_revision']!=revision:raise ReplayError('stale-revision')
101	            candidates=[r for r in rules if r.get('on')==event.get('kind') and all(guard_holds(g,state,event) for g in r.get('guards',[]))]
102	            if len(candidates)!=1:raise ReplayError('no-enabled-rule' if not candidates else 'ambiguous-rules')
103	            rule=candidates[0];candidate=copy.deepcopy(state)
104	            for effect in rule.get('effects',[]):mutate(candidate,effect,event)
105	            state=candidate;revision+=1;seen.add(eid)
106	            receipt.update({'outcome':'applied','rule':rule['id']})
107	        except (ReplayError,KeyError,TypeError) as exc:
108	            receipt.update({'outcome':'rejected','reason':str(exc)})
109	        receipt.update({'after_revision':revision,'after_hash':digest(state),'state':copy.deepcopy(state)})
110	        receipts.append(receipt)
111	    return {'engine':VERSION,'model_hash':fingerprint,'revision':revision,'state':state,'seen':sorted(seen),'receipts':receipts,
112	            'scope':'Replay of explicitly authored finite transitions only; no proof of all executions, prose interpretation, liveness, or historical truth.'}
113	
114	def main():
115	    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
116	    parser.add_argument('fixture',type=Path);parser.add_argument('--compact',action='store_true')
117	    args=parser.parse_args();fixture=json.loads(args.fixture.read_text());result=run(fixture['model'],fixture['events'])
118	    if args.compact:result['receipts']=[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='state'} for r in result['receipts']]
119	    print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
120	    return 1 if any(r['outcome']=='rejected' for r in result['receipts']) else 0
121	
122	if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())

1	"""One finite-trace pattern checker. Outcomes concern the pattern, never the whole claim."""
2	import copy, hashlib, json
3	import formalcheck
4	CHECKER_VERSION = 'exclusive-actor/3'
5	SCOPE_NOTE = 'Checks the recorded chooser role after a linked ended attempt. Does not check consultation, liveness, trace truth, or all possible behavior.'
6	
7	def fingerprint(node):
8	    content=copy.deepcopy(node)
9	    if isinstance(content.get('meta'),dict):
10	        for field in ('review_state','review_reason','layout','position','color','reviewed_inputs','reviewed_input_versions','review_roots','sources','aliases','title'): content['meta'].pop(field,None)
11	        if not content['meta']: content.pop('meta')
12	    content.pop('result_state',None)
13	    for field in ('layout','position','color','reviewed_inputs','reviewed_input_versions','review_roots','sources','aliases','title','semantic_version'): content.pop(field,None)
14	    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(content,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
15	
16	def provenance(g, roots):
17	    """Declared provenance only: adjacency and supporting reasons are not dependencies.
18	
19	    Edges are captured as a closure signature too, so replacing a source edge stales
20	    a result even when neither endpoint's content changes.
21	    """
22	    seen=set(); links={}; missing=set(); pending=list(roots)
23	    while pending:
24	        current=pending.pop()
25	        if not isinstance(current,str) or current in seen: continue
26	        seen.add(current)
27	        node=g.get('nodes',{}).get(current)
28	        if node is None: missing.add(current); continue
29	        for edge_id,edge in sorted(g.get('edges',{}).items()):
30	            if edge.get('from')==current and (edge.get('type') in ('extracted-from','depends-on') or g.get('edge_types',{}).get(edge.get('type'),{}).get('invalidation')=='dependent-to-prerequisite'):
31	                links[edge_id]=fingerprint(edge)
32	                pending.append(edge.get('to'))
33	        declared=node.get('provenance',{})
34	        if isinstance(declared,dict):
35	            for source in declared.get('sources',[]):
36	                pending.append(source if isinstance(source,str) else source.get('id') if isinstance(source,dict) else None)
37	    return {'nodes':sorted(seen),'missing':sorted(missing),'edges':links,
38	            'fingerprints':{i:fingerprint(g['nodes'][i]) if i in g['nodes'] else None for i in sorted(seen)}}
39	
40	def classify(g, result):
41	    trace=g['nodes'].get(result.get('trace'),{})
42	    claim=g['nodes'].get(result.get('claim'),{})
43	    polarity=trace.get('polarity',(trace.get('meta') or {}).get('polarity','unspecified'))
44	    findings=[]
45	    if polarity=='intended' and result['outcome']=='violates' and claim.get('status')=='accepted':
46	        findings.append({'code':'intention-theory-mismatch','possible_causes':['claim wrong','case mislabeled','extraction wrong']})
47	    if polarity=='defect' and result['outcome']=='satisfies' and not result.get('vacuous') and not result.get('permission_only'):
48	        findings.append({'code':'known-defect-unexplained','scope':'The checked fragment does not explain this defect; this is not a contradiction.'})
49	    return {'polarity':polarity,'findings':findings,
50	            'evidence_basis':result.get('evidence_basis','recorded-events' if result.get('checked_events') else 'unspecified'),
51	            'empirical_support':False if result.get('vacuous') or result.get('permission_only') or result.get('synthetic') else None,
52	            'historical_behavior': 'not-established' if result.get('synthetic') else 'source-dependent',
53	            'reachability':{'outcome':'not-checked','reason':'No rewrite reachability engine is implemented. Explaining an observed defect requires implementation rules, not necessarily intended rules.'}}
54	
55	def evaluate(g,claim_id,trace_id):
56	    claim,trace=g['nodes'][claim_id],g['nodes'][trace_id]
57	    result={'claim':claim_id,'trace':trace_id,'outcome':'not-checked','witnesses':[],'diagnostics':[],'checked_events':[],'out_of_scope_events':[],
58	            'input_fingerprints':{claim_id:fingerprint(claim),trace_id:fingerprint(trace)},'computed_revision':g['revision'],'checker_version':CHECKER_VERSION,
59	            'scope':SCOPE_NOTE,'synthetic':bool((trace.get('meta') or {}).get('synthetic'))}
60	    declared=provenance(g,[claim_id,trace_id])
61	    result['claim_standing']=claim.get('status','unspecified')
62	    result['pattern_standing']=(claim.get('meta') or {}).get('pattern_standing','unspecified')
63	    result['provenance']=declared
64	    result['input_fingerprints'].update(declared['fingerprints'])
65	    result['provenance_roots']=[claim_id,trace_id]
66	    result['synthetic']=result['synthetic'] or any((g['nodes'].get(i,{}).get('meta') or {}).get('synthetic') is True for i in declared['nodes'])
67	    def finish():
68	        result['assessment']=classify(g,result)
69	        return result
70	    def dependency(i):
71	        if isinstance(i,str): result['input_fingerprints'][i]=fingerprint(g['nodes'][i]) if i in g['nodes'] else None
72	    def is_role(i):
73	        n=g['nodes'].get(i,{}) if isinstance(i,str) else {}
74	        return n.get('type')=='entity' and (n.get('meta') or {}).get('kind')=='agent-role'
75	    def diagnostic(code,event=None,detail=None):
76	        result['diagnostics'].append({'code':code,**({'event':event} if event is not None else {}),**({'detail':detail} if detail else {})})
